name: Antonio Ascari
features: olive skin, dark hair, brown eyes, mustache, medium build, strong jaw, intense gaze
bio: Antonio Ascari was an Italian racing driver and father of Alberto Ascari. He was one of the finest drivers of the 1920s, winning the 1924 and 1925 Italian Grand Prix for Alfa Romeo. He died leading the 1925 French Grand Prix at Montlhéry.
